## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `778a8c54c2c93db9a7b4657215d0e8408f13a353`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md + none

Read: card #32906 body and its three comments (claims 6838546898, 6838670868, 6838796788; the card carries no dev report, so the dev's flags are read off the PR body), PR #32918 body, file list and net diff `origin/main...778a8c54` (8 files, +20/−20, merge base `bfbcd81f`), the head's check-runs, and PR #32894's two overlapping files. Nothing built or run.

Check-runs on the head: 46 total — 16 success, 25 skipped, 0 failed, 5 still in progress: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`. The card's 「skills gates are green」 is therefore not yet shown by CI on this head; the PR body's local-gate table is the dev's account, not evidence.

### ① Derived judgments

Every rule-text change, judged against the tree at the head:

- `filing-gate.md:40–43` four grade rows — RIGHT against the card's table, clause for clause (see ④). The p2 row adds 「⛔ 不沿链齐平升 p1」, a gloss the table does not carry; it is a fair reading of the row, but it is the clause that collides with `dispatch-runbook.md:175` (④ M1).
- `filing-gate.md:44` focus-feature weighting — RIGHT (one row up, user- or agent-reachable defect, prose follow-ups no bump, list pointed to `lanes/triage.md`). No ceiling stated (④ S1).
- `filing-gate.md:45` 「协议类」 renamed 「协议增项」, definition kept with `:46` — RIGHT; it is the term rows p1/p2 use. Nit: the name says addition while the definition still counts narrowings and fixes (「宽窄皆算」).
- `filing-gate.md` old `:42` (every protocol change p1 + in-flight major `target:`, 「本节余条不压」) removed — RIGHT, the card orders it replaced. The precedence clause goes with it; no line now says which of the table and the kept clauses wins (④ S3).
- `filing-gate.md` old `:43–45` (consumer follow-ups, 「坏用户」, first-cards-of-the-next-major) removed — RIGHT, see ③(3).
- `filing-gate.md` old `:51` (chain inheritance: upper bound, wall level, tax one down) removed — the removal follows from the p2 row, but its counterpart outside the diff was left standing (④ M1).
- `lanes/triage.md:15` — the new line is RIGHT against Work 2 (pointer, list value MCP with the card's scope, maintainer confirms changes). The line it replaced: see ③(2).
- `seat-post-protocol.md:78–88` (7 lines) — RIGHT in direction: heading, producers, 「其余座位不为发版升降 p0」, the maintainer's query, 「撤 p0」, 「明示接受 = 回 p1」. The query `label:priority:p0 is:open` is no longer a pure blocker list (④ S2).
- `lanes/director.md:79,82`, `lanes/cloud.md:28` — RIGHT; the board is named by the p0 raise, the binary test and the four blocker classes are untouched.
- `seat-lifecycle.md:77` — RIGHT in direction, same impurity as the query (④ S2).
- `execution-duties.md:53` — RIGHT: with blockers at `priority:p0` the 「`target:` 板上项」 rank has no members.
- `project-forms.md:41` 「p0/p1 发版阻塞」 to 「p0 发版阻塞」 — RIGHT on the grade; the sender is now doubtful (④ S4).

### ② Semver level

None. All 8 paths are under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`; nothing published, no `skills/**`, no package. `skip-changeset` is correct and `Check Changeset` is green on the head. `Clause-②: no` holds: no published schema, no accept/reject behaviour, no consumer-visible surface changes. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

(1) `SKILL.md:115` left open — ESCALATED, accepted as carried. The PR is `Part of #32906`, so the card stays open; claim 6838796788 puts the row on a second PR under `Fixes #32906`. Interim coherence: the row still reads 「`target:MAJOR` | 发版阻塞:每个 backlog 恰好一个生产者」 while `filing-gate.md:40` says 「⛔ 不打 `target:`」. That is a real contradiction on `main` for as long as the gap lasts, but it misleads narrowly: every operating line a producer follows (seat-post-protocol 发版板节, director `:79`, cloud `:28`) and the maintainer's query now say p0, and the row describes a label rather than ordering a write. The one bad outcome is a producer who marks by `target:` alone and is then invisible to the p0 query, so the two PRs should land together or this one first with the second close behind. Not a must-fix here: this branch may not author that path. Also stale for the same reason and carried by NO claim: `lanes/hotcrm.md:41` 「无发版板:标签清单无 `target:*`」 — the conclusion still holds, the reason no longer does (should-fix, ④ S5).

(2) `lanes/triage.md` cut of 「不推:定级、治半状态、解锁、契约复核(归复核席,`review.md`)、门铃答复、健康绿读数」 — ANSWERED, no rule lost. `:8` bounds every push by 「推维护者仅限需其出手」 and `:9–14` enumerate ①–⑦; none of the six cut items needs the maintainer's hand, so each is already excluded. The routing of contract review to the review seat lives in `lanes/review.md` and `project-forms.md:37`. No other file and no script under `scripts/pm` quotes the cut line. What is lost is emphasis against a known failure (pushing green readings), not a rule: nit.

(3) `filing-gate.md` removals — ANSWERED. The card's keep-list names the checklist-item, false-green and reach-bound clauses; all are present unchanged at `:47–52`, as are the Instruments line and the North Star rule-4 lines. None of the removed lines is on the keep-list.
  - Consumer follow-up line and its 「坏用户」 definition: superseded. The two harms it named grade by the table (designer systematically writes rejected metadata = core task blocked, p1; declared block renders empty = user-visible defect, p2 or p1). Precision lost, no rule lost: nit.
  - First-cards-of-the-next-major line: a scheduling rule of the protocol class the card orders replaced; under the table a follow-up the release needs is p1 or a window p0, the rest p3. Superseded, and named in the PR as conflict 2.
  - Chain-inheritance line: superseded by the p2 row only in `filing-gate.md`. The same inheritance is still ordered elsewhere — NOT reconciled (④ M1). The PR names the conflict but not the surviving lines.
  - Not named in the PR although the card asks for it: the precedence between the table and the kept checklist-item clause (④ S3).

(4) Commit re-created for a model-free trailer — ANSWERED. `218653d3` ends with `Co-Authored-By: Claude` and a `Claude-Session:` line, no model identifier. The claim that the re-created tree is byte-identical to the one the local gates ran on cannot be checked from the PR and need not be: CI on this head is the evidence, and five runs are still in progress. Nits: the merge commit `778a8c54` carries no trailer pair; the PR body names the second thread's tier by a model family word twice where the tier constant belongs.

Out-of-scope items the dev named — CONFIRMED, and none has a carrier yet:
  - `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` Priority rule 2 (grade by road and checklist, 「never re-grade card by card」) and rule 3 (an instrument card that unblocks a product P0/P1 inherits its priority along the chain) both conflict with the table; `filing-gate.md:38` still titles the section as their execution note and `triage-duties.md:60` still sends triage to 「北极星 Priority 1–3 条」. North Star is maintainer text: this belongs on a `needs-user-decision` card (or a maintainer edit), filed by the seat. 「Carrier: the maintainer」 in a PR body reaches no one.
  - `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh:664–683` still creates `target:` labels described as 「Release blocker for …」 and documents the `label:target:` query; `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs:1320` still says 「a p0/p1 release blocker」; `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (`:17499`, `:17540`, `:19027`, battery H67) still describes `target:` board membership as a leg of 取卡全序. All three belong on ONE `tooling` follow-up card in the lane that owns `scripts/pm` (p3 by the new table), not on this PR. 「Carrier: none; noted」 is a loose end.

### ④ Design judgment

Table, weighting, window rule against the card:
- p0 `:40` — main or merge queue red; release blocker raised for the window only, no `target:`, back to p1 after the release. EXACT.
- p1 `:41` — data silently wrong or lost; security boundary; core task blocked with no workaround; protocol addition the release needs. EXACT.
- p2 `:42` — user-visible defect with a workaround; ordinary protocol addition; process or tooling card blocking p1 work. EXACT, plus the gloss noted in ①.
- p3 default `:43` — review nits, loose ends, docs and skills follow-ups after landing, other process improvements; raised to p2 when a real user can hit it. EXACT.
- Focus weighting — rule at `filing-gate.md:44`, list (MCP), its scope and maintainer confirmation at `lanes/triage.md:15`. Each half once.
- Stated once: the table once; the weighting once, split as Work 1/2 ask; the window rule once at `:40`. `seat-post-protocol.md:80` points to it; `:88` 「明示接受 = 回 p1」 and the 「窗内升 `priority:p0`」 parentheticals in director/cloud/seat-lifecycle name the mark, they do not restate the rule. Acceptable.
- Leftover search (`target:`, 发版阻塞, 在研大版, 协议类 across `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch` and `AGENTS.md`): no text grades every protocol addition p1. `target:` as a blocker mark survives only at `SKILL.md:115` (known gap) and by implication at `lanes/hotcrm.md:41`. `AGENTS.md`: no hit.
- Line budgets: all 8 files keep their line count (190, 67, 28, 86, 20, 59, 98, 88), each equal to its ceiling in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` on `main`; the script is not in the diff. Longest new line 120 B (`lanes/triage.md:15`, at the cap), the rest 86–119 B. No re-wrap, no table row.
- PR #32894 (head `67a5c231`): `execution-duties.md` — its nearest hunk rewrites old `:49` and ends at context `:52`; this PR changes `:53`. Changed lines are disjoint with three unchanged lines between, counts stay net zero on both sides; the second to land needs a merge of `main` and a ratchet re-read. `seat-post-protocol.md` — it changes `:65`, this PR `:78–88`: disjoint. Its rewrite of `:49` drops 「p0/p1 优先级沿链传递」, which removes one of the two lines behind M1 once it lands.

Findings:

- **M1 (must-fix).** `dispatch-runbook.md:175` on this head still orders 「父卡 p0/p1 ⇒ 阻塞卡同笔升同级,沿链重复」, and `execution-duties.md:49`, four lines above this PR's own edit, still says 「p0/p1 优先级沿链传递」. `filing-gate.md:42` now says a process or tooling card that blocks p1 work is p2, 「⛔ 不沿链齐平升 p1」. For that card the references give two opposite label writes: the execution seat raises it to p1 in the same write, triage grades it p2 and is forbidden the raise. On `main` the removed line (「沿链继承只给上界 … 税降一格」) was what made these agree; this PR removes the reconciler and adds the prohibition, so the contradiction is new with this head, and it sits on the exact row the ruling exists for (process cards inflating p1). The PR's 「Conflicts reconciled」 item 3 names the filing-gate line only. It also leaves a pick-order seam: `execution-duties.md:50` applies North Star rule 3 (no p2/p3 tooling card while the lane holds an open P0/P1) to a card that the label order ranks, by `pm:blocking`, above p1. Fix: restate the claim's file surface and reconcile `dispatch-runbook.md:175` in place (119 B, headroom 0), scoping the raise so it does not reach process and tooling cards or pointing it at 定级判据; `execution-duties.md:49` either here or left to #32894, said in the PR; and say in one of the touched lines that such a card rides `pm:blocking` for its turn, not its grade.
- **S1 (should-fix, escalate).** 「上调一档」 has no ceiling. Read literally a p1 defect in MCP becomes p0, which carries preemption (`SKILL.md:117`) and puts it on the release board and in the 发版阻塞 metric. The card's wording has the same gap, so this is a one-line question to the maintainer (does the bump stop at p1?), not a defect of the transcription. It is also unstated whether the bump stacks on p3's 「真实用户可撞 ⇒ p2」.
- **S2 (should-fix).** With the mark fused into the grade, `label:priority:p0 is:open` (`seat-post-protocol.md:82`) and 「窗内三仓 open `priority:p0` 之和」 (`seat-lifecycle.md:77`) count main-red anchor cards and, under S1, bumped cards as release blockers, so 「归零 = 可发版」 can read non-zero with an empty board. That follows from the maintainer's own 「阻塞卡升 p0」, so it is not a must-fix, but one clause should say the list is every open p0 in the window. 「三仓」 was defined by where `target:` labels existed; `priority:p0` exists in every repo, so the three now need naming. 「发版窗」 has no stated opener or closer.
- **S3 (should-fix).** Precedence between the table and the kept clauses is unstated and unnamed in the PR: a failing checklist item inherits its item's grade (`:47`) while the table would give p2 for the same defect with a workaround. The reach-bound line reads as a cap by its own words (「定上界」), which is enough; the checklist clause has no such word.
- **S4 (should-fix).** `project-forms.md:41` keeps triage as the sender of `Notify: release-blocker` for a 「p0 发版阻塞定入」, but `seat-post-protocol.md:81` now reserves the release p0 to the two producers. Before, grade (triage) and board mark (producer) were separate acts; fused, the line names a sender who can no longer produce the event.
- **S5 (should-fix).** `lanes/hotcrm.md:41` — reword or carry it with the `SKILL.md:115` PR; today no claim covers it.
- Nits: 「协议增项」 naming; the director line now reads 「升 `priority:p0`」 next to 「⛔ 不做优先级渐变」; `lanes/triage.md:15` and `filing-gate.md:44` cite each other by bare relative paths in two different styles; merge commit without trailers; tier named by a model family word in the PR body.

FAIL on M1 alone. Everything the card's Acceptance enumerates is met in the eight files except the `SKILL.md:115` row, which is escalated and carried.

Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4cwTZvo7tAGwbbRW2b8`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `caf0eaf9743e1f551b2fb2b1f0e0ab56ea4a6809`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md + none

This is a delta review over record 6839135184 (head `778a8c54`, FAIL on M1). Its judgments on the unchanged hunks carry to this head and are not repeated. Read: the round-2 delta `778a8c54..caf0eaf9` (one commit, 4 files, +4/−4), the claim restatement 6839183315 on card #32906, the PR body's 「Conflicts reconciled」 items 3, 5 and 6, the neighbouring lines of each changed line at the head, PR #32894's `execution-duties.md` at its head `67a5c231`, and the head's check-runs. Nothing built or run.

Check-runs on the head: 47 total — 23 success, 24 skipped, 0 failed, 0 in progress. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` are green, so the line ratchet and the id-lint are shown by CI on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

The four changed lines, each judged against the tree at the head:

- `dispatch-runbook.md:175` — 「父卡 p0/p1 ⇒ 产品阻塞卡同笔升同级,沿链重复」. RIGHT. The raise along the chain now reaches product blocker cards only. A process or tooling blocker is no longer raised by this line.
- `filing-gate.md:42` — 「挡 p1 的流程或工具卡(靠 `pm:blocking` 排先,不升级)」 replaces 「⛔ 不沿链齐平升 p1」. RIGHT. It keeps the card's p2 row, and it now says where such a card gets its turn: from `pm:blocking`, which `execution-duties.md:53` ranks above p1. That was the second half of the M1 fix.
- `project-forms.md:41` — sender of `Notify: release-blocker` is now 「发版板生产者→车道」. RIGHT against `seat-post-protocol.md:80–81`, which gives the release p0 to the two producers only. S4 is cleared in the prose (one residue in ④).
- `seat-post-protocol.md:82` — adds 「列窗内全部 open p0」. RIGHT. The reader is told the query is every open p0, not a pure blocker list. The first half of S2 is cleared.

### ② Semver level

None, unchanged. All 9 paths are under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`. Nothing published changes. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` still hold.

### ③ Boundary flags

(1) M1 — CLEARED.
  - The pair is consistent. `filing-gate.md:42` grades a process or tooling blocker p2 and forbids the raise. `dispatch-runbook.md:175` orders the raise for product blocker cards only. For one card the two lines now give the same label write.
  - 「产品阻塞卡」 is not defined on the line, but a reader can apply it. 「产品卡」 is already the working term in `lanes/devx.md:14`, `lanes/skills.md:12`, `lanes/spec.md:13` and `triage-duties.md:39`, always as the opposite of a `tooling` card. `SKILL.md:114` defines `tooling` as a fix that lands in gates, scripts, workflows, skills, seat protocol or PM tools 「而非产品包」. So the test is the `tooling` label: a blocker card without it is a product blocker card. 「流程或工具卡」 in `filing-gate.md:42` covers the same set. Neither line names the label; that is a nit, not a gap.
  - `execution-duties.md:49` still reads 「p0/p1 优先级沿链传递」 on this head, unscoped. This is a real leftover, and it is ACCEPTED as transient. Reasons: record 6839135184 offered this route (「either here or left to #32894, said in the PR」); the PR body item 3 and the restated claim both say it; PR #32894 is open, not a draft, and its head rewrites `:49` to 「阻塞项在飞 ⇒ 等;卡 PR 叠未合 PR …」 with no chain clause. Until #32894 lands, a reader has one general line against two specific ones. `dispatch-runbook.md:175` sits in the section that is the detail of `:49` (「阻塞项三类细则」), and `filing-gate.md` owns grading, so the specific pair governs. The risk is #32894 closing or being rewritten to keep the clause; then `:49` has no carrier. See ④ S6.
  - The pick-order seam named under M1 is narrowed, not gone. `execution-duties.md:50` still applies North Star rule 3 as a pre-condition, and rule 3's second sentence (an instrument card that unblocks a product P0/P1 inherits its priority) is the opposite of 「不升级」. The operating lines do not stall the card: `execution-duties.md:8` and `triage-duties.md:63` close only a `tooling` card with none of the three gates, and a tooling card that blocks a p1 has the first gate (`Unblocks: #N`). The conflict that remains is with North Star text, which record 6839135184 ③ already sent to a `needs-user-decision` card. Carried, not re-opened.

(2) Claimed surface — HELD. The delta touches four files, all in the restated claim. `dispatch-runbook.md` differs from `main` in line 175 only (1 line for 1 line). `execution-duties.md:49` is untouched, as the claim says.

(3) New commit `caf0eaf9` — trailer pair present, no model identifier.

### ④ Design judgment

Mechanics of the delta:
- Line counts unchanged and equal to the ratchet ceilings: `dispatch-runbook.md` 245, `filing-gate.md` 67, `project-forms.md` 59, `seat-post-protocol.md` 88. The ratchet script is not in the diff.
- New lines are 118 B (`dispatch-runbook.md:175`), 119 B (`filing-gate.md:42`), 116 B (`project-forms.md:41`), 112 B (`seat-post-protocol.md:82`). All under the 120-byte cap. `filing-gate.md:5` is 252 B on `main` too and is not in the diff.
- No re-wrap. Each change is one line replaced by one line in the same position.

Findings:

- **M1 — cleared.** See ③(1).
- **S4 — cleared in the prose; one residue (should-fix, not this PR).** `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs:1320` still lists `notify:release-blocker` with `from: 'triage'` and 「a p0/p1 release blocker is graded into a lane」, and `--mailbox-keys` prints that row. After this PR the script roster and `project-forms.md:41` name different senders. The script is outside the claim and no gate compares the sender (the PM gates are green). Add it to the one `tooling` follow-up card that record 6839135184 ③ asked for; that card is still unfiled.
- **S2 — half cleared.** The query line is fixed. `seat-lifecycle.md:77` still sums 「三仓」 without naming them, and no line says who opens or closes 「发版窗」. Carried as should-fix.
- **S6 (should-fix, new).** `execution-duties.md:49` depends on PR #32894 landing with its current text. The seat should re-read `:49` when either PR lands second, and take the line on a card if #32894 closes or keeps the chain clause. The second PR to land needs a merge of `main` on `execution-duties.md` (changed lines 49 and 53 are disjoint).
- S1, S3, S5 of record 6839135184 are not touched by the delta and carry unchanged as should-fixes.
- Nits: `dispatch-runbook.md:175` and `filing-gate.md:42` lost their closing 「。」 to fit the cap; `seat-post-protocol.md:82` says 「窗内」 though the query also lists p0 cards outside a window; `project-forms.md:41` no longer states the event (a card raised to release p0), only the key; neither chain line names the `tooling` label.

PASS. The one must-fix of 6839135184 is cleared, no new break is found, and CI on this head is fully green. The should-fixes above do not block.
